title: 第20章 这个矿场不对劲！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
清风宗灵矿场周围，师徒二人静静蛰伏下来。

    李应灵小心翼翼的抬头看去，观察着下方情况，同时目光紧紧盯着自己的二师弟，有些担忧道：

    “师父，二师弟这样会不会太冒险了？”

    “理论上，你比他更危险。”

    闻言，李应灵略显疑惑的看向自家师父。

    楚星尘这么说自然有理由，能抵御金丹期攻击的护符厉行天此刻还带在身上，还有两张传送符。

    要说出了问题谁跑的最快，那自然便是厉行天，所以单纯按照危险程度来拍的话，自己身边的李应灵才更危险一点。

    此刻厉行天正伪装成矿工混入了矿场。

    正如同厉行天推测那般，那群清风宗的核心弟子，压根不会认真对比矿场之中那些蝼蚁多了或者少了。

    加上确实挖过几年矿，厉行天在这里轻车熟路，伪装的还挺顺畅。

    此刻他正推着车，目光扫过路过的所有人。

    寻找宁芊芊的父亲。

    破庙中，楚星尘已经根据宁芊芊的描述，给宁芊芊的父亲画了一幅素描，其逼真程度已经得到了宁芊芊的首肯。

    所以只要宁芊芊的父亲还活在这个矿场，也不存在遇见了不认识的情况。

    楚星尘微微放松，这样看来备用计划暂时还用不上了。

    现在只要等到厉行天的信号。

    宁芊芊毫无修为，带着没意义，可能还得分心照顾，所以直接留在破庙之中更为合适。

    所以参与这个行动的只有师徒三人。

    其中厉行天作为观测者，对矿场进行仔细观察，同时找到宁芊芊的父亲。

    楚星尘作为攻坚者，到时候会直击金丹镇守的灵石仓库，同时吸引所有人的注意力，来为自己的徒弟撤退做好掩护。

    李应灵则是补位，如果有特殊情况，则是会上场兜底。

    另外！如果一切都非常顺利，厉行天还布置了终极计划！

    弄碎这个该死的矿场，释放里面的所有人。

    虽然楚星尘并不看好这个计划，而且将这些人全放了也不一定是个好主意。

    因为清风宗必然会追查这些人的下落，随后审问他们。

    不过厉行天表示呆在那里是必死无疑，试着逃出去才有活路，他做的只是让那群人有活路，更何况不想跑的大可以不跑。

    对于厉行天的方案，楚星尘提出更直接些，等实力够了直接干碎那个该死的清风宗。

    厉行天倒是没反对师父的决议，只是欲言又止之后还是点头同意。

    不过想来是厉行天觉得自己的这个方案并不靠谱。
content_en:
Around the Qingfeng Zongling Mine, the master and the apprentice lay dormant quietly.

Li Yingling looked up carefully, observing the situation below. At the same time, he stared closely at his second junior brother and said with some worry:

"Master, second junior brother, isn't this too risky?"

"Theoretically, you are more dangerous than him."

Hearing this, Li Yingling looked at his master with confusion.

Chu Xingchen had a reason for saying this. Li Xingtian was still carrying the amulet that could withstand attacks from the golden elixir stage, as well as two teleportation amulets.

If there is a problem, who runs the fastest is naturally Li Xingtian. Therefore, if you shoot based on the degree of danger, Li Yingling next to you is more dangerous.

At this moment, Li Xingtian was disguised as a miner and sneaked into the mine.

Just as Li Xingtian speculated, the core disciples of the Qingfeng Sect would not seriously compare whether there were more or less ants in the mine.

In addition, he had actually mined for several years, so Li Xingtian was familiar with the roads here and his disguise was quite smooth.

At this moment, he was pushing the cart, looking at everyone passing by.

Looking for Ning Qianqian’s father.

In the ruined temple, Chu Xingchen had already drawn a sketch of Ning Qianqian's father based on Ning Qianqian's description, and Ning Qianqian's approval was given to the degree of realism.

So as long as Ning Qianqian's father is still alive in this mine, there is no chance that he will meet someone he doesn't recognize.

Chu Xingchen relaxed slightly. It seemed that the backup plan was not available for the time being.

Now we just have to wait for Li Xingtian's signal.

Ning Qianqian has no cultivation, her life is meaningless, and she may need to be taken care of, so it is more appropriate to stay in the ruined temple.

Therefore, only three masters and apprentices participated in this operation.

Among them, Li Xingtian, as the observer, carefully observed the mine and found Ning Qianqian's father.

As the attacker, Chu Xingchen will directly attack the spiritual stone warehouse guarded by Jindan, and at the same time attract everyone's attention to cover his disciple's retreat.

Li Yingling is a fill-in, and if there are special circumstances, he will play to cover.

in addition!If everything goes very smoothly, Li Xingtian has also laid out the ultimate plan!

Crush this damn mine and free everyone inside.

Although Chu Xingchen was not optimistic about this plan, and letting all these people go was not necessarily a good idea.

Because Qingfeng Sect will definitely trace the whereabouts of these people and then interrogate them.

However, Li Xingtian said that staying there would lead to death, and trying to escape was the only way to survive. What he did was just to let the group of people have a way to survive, not to mention that those who didn't want to run didn't have to run away.

Regarding Li Xingtian's plan, Chu Xingchen proposed to be more direct, to crush that damn Qingfeng Sect directly when he was strong enough.

Li Xingtian didn't object to his master's decision, but he hesitated and nodded in agreement.

But it seems that Li Xingtian felt that his plan was not reliable.
